subject: literacy
concept: Identifying a text's theme and distinguishing it from its topic
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts statement cards into 'topic' (what it's about) and 'theme' (what it says about life) categories for a familiar story
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a short passage to its correct theme among several plausible options
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the theme of a given passage and explains the textual evidence supporting it

misconception_flags: states the topic (e.g. 'friendship') rather than an actual theme (e.g. 'true friendship requires honesty even when it's hard')

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
